root_idea.summary: The root has two principal orientations: seeking or desiring something, and spaciousness or abundance in something.
root_idea.development: The seeking branch develops into desire, directed longing, aversion when used with عَنْ, and petition or supplication when used with إِلَى. The spaciousness branch describes capacity, breadth, abundance, and related extensions such as voracity and large gifts.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the singular active-participle citation form.
Displayed as an ordinary verbal noun expressing earnest desire or hope.

senses.definition: To desire, wish for, or earnestly turn toward something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with فِي or إِلَى for directed desire or longing. The Quranic uses include desiring a matter, turning one's attention toward a Lord or object, and preferring one course over another.

senses.definition: To turn away from, shun, abstain from, or relinquish something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ. The related construction رَغِبَ بِنَفْسِهِ عَنْهُ expresses holding oneself aloof from or above something; it is attested in the Quranic expression involving not holding oneself back from the Messenger.

senses.definition: Desiring, hoping for, or turning earnestly toward something.
senses.usage_conditions: With فِي or إِلَى, the participle denotes a person whose desire or hope is directed toward an object, person, or God.

senses.definition: Turning away from or disinclined toward something.
senses.usage_conditions: With عَنْ, the participle denotes repudiation, aversion, or withdrawal of desire from the object.
A verbal noun expressing breadth or intensity of will; in the Quran it occurs alongside fear as a motive accompanying supplication.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To petition, ask, seek, or supplicate someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use with إِلَى, often implying humility, earnestness, or self-abasement in making the request.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become wide, spacious, or ample; of land or a valley, to have the capacity to receive much water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to valleys, land, and other expanses; this is the spaciousness branch rather than the desire branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be voracious or gluttonous, and excessively desirous of food or worldly goods; to have large hopes and desires.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived extension from largeness or capaciousness, applied to appetite, acquisitiveness, or expansive hopes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be liberal or bountiful, with broadness of judgment or opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's judgment or disposition in the reported figurative expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone desire or wish for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative construction, commonly followed by فِي or expressing the thing desired.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone what he desires or wishes for.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form II usage in which the verb denotes granting the desired object rather than producing desire for it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make wide or ample; to enlarge or extend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported Form IV usage includes the idiomatic wish that God enlarge a person's power and extend its reach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie with one another in desiring something or to desire it competitively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction, synonymous with competing or emulating one another in pursuit of an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a place to be or become wide or ample.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative Form VI use applied to a place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desire or wish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A deverbal noun with a plural referring to multiple desires or wishes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who petitions, asks, seeks, or supplicates with humility or earnestness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet for a person, derived from the petitionary use of رَغِبَ إِلَيْهِ or from رَغْبَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The knot beneath the sandal strap, the part called سَعْدَانَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for a component of a sandal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soft, broad land with even or sandy soil that absorbs much water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَرْضٌ رَغَابٌ; the land is said not to flow unless after much rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide, ample, or spacious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a watering place, tank, water or milk skin, road, valley, place, wound, sword, or a horse with a broad stride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a capacious interior or belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person or other animal, especially with reference to bodily capacity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Voracious, a great eater, or intensely desirous of much food or worldly goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the idiom رَغِيبُ الْجَوْفِ and the expression رَغِيبُ الْعَيْنِ for one content only with much.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Camels yielding abundant milk, or a large number of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural expression extending the notion of abundance to livestock and their produce.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A heavy or substantial load.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional adjectival use describing the size or burden of a load.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing desired, wished for, or held in high estimation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural رَغَائِبُ denotes desired or highly valued things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large or generous gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension of something greatly desired or abundant; the plural is رَغَائِبُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large recompense desired to be obtained through prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The specialized expression صَلَاةُ الرَّغَائِبِ is associated with the hoped-for recompense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The appendage or enlargement of the liver called زِيَادَةُ الْكَبِدِ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical term, synonymous with the cited names for this liver structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exceedingly desirous of much eating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjectival form focused specifically on appetite.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or time of desire, and hence an object or goal of desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote the desired objective attained by a person's request or pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possessing competence, sufficiency, wealth, or much property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative adjectival use connected with abundance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Desired or wished for.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle with فِي denotes that something is an object of desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Not desired, shunned, or avoided.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle with عَنْ expresses withdrawal of desire from the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Petitioned or supplicated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle with إِلَى denotes the person to whom a petition is directed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Allowed or permitted to have something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported passive Form II expression concerning what is made available to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Things eagerly desired or coveted, especially things sought for subsistence or livelihood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural expression for desired acquisitions or means of sustenance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large, big, bulky, or corpulent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative or assumed-tropical use applied to a man.
